{{Quote|Comra's the logical spot to pick up a transmission coming from Nirauan or Chiss space.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="SQ" />}}
'''Comra''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]], within the [[Dead Zone]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Quote|I know that you have befriended Hutts in your own planetary neighborhood.''"<br />"''It's true that Drixo and Progga have done well for themselves on Comra, but their successes came at a high cost. What are you offering in return for our investment?|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Hutt]]<ref name="DP" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]]<ref name="Progga">{{CSWECite|III|52|Progga the Hutt}}</ref> [[Progga]] and [[Drixo]]<ref name="Drixo">{{CSWECite|I|224|Drixo the Hutt}}</ref> made successful investments with the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] on Comra.<ref name="DP" /> By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Comra had become Drixo's headquarters.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

By [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Comra was later the location of a communications relay station of [[Talon Karrde]] and was apparently considered by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to be the known inhabited world closest to either the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] or the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="SQ" />
